Daddyda's Sauce (Ginger Orange Teriyaki Sauce) approximately 1 quart. A VanOrman Original
§ion;
We love eating Chinese food. We usually use bottle after bottle of Yoshida's sauce. But one night, we started making Teriyaki chicken and found we didn't have any!
So Ransom decided to try making his own. The first try was excellent, and the second was even better, but the third time topped them all!
Since it is better than Yoshida's sauce, and since it was made by "Daddy," we decided to call it Daddyda's Sauce.
Soy Sauce1 Cup Flour¼ Cup Corn Syrup3 Cups Brown Sugar1 Cup Minced Garlic1 Tablespoon
OnionVery Finely Chopped 1 Tablespoon
Fresh GingerFinely Grated 2 Tablespoons
Chinese Mustard1 Tablespoon 1 OrangeZest From
Hot Chili SauceOptional 1 Tablespoon
Crushed Red PeppersOptional ½ Tablespoon
Put the Soy Sauce and Flour into a pan.
Without heating, mix very well with a wisk until there are absolutely no lumps left.
Add all of the other ingredients and stir well. Over medium heat, bring to a simmering boil. Remove from heat immediately.
This sauce can be used immediately, or it can be placed into a bottle and saved for later. (We usually end up using some and saving some for later.)
We use it in various ways:
Put it over stir-fry vegetables for a wonderful Chinese food dish.
Pour it over rice or noodles.
Use it as a sauce for cooking Teriyaki Chicken.
Substitute Very Finely Chopped Onion with ½ Tablespoon Onion Powder.
